name: calendar-docs
gates: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['docs/usage.md','docs/es/usage.md']) { const t=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'); for (const need of ['calendar: true','train-calendar-light.svg','example-calendar.svg']) if(!t.includes(need)){console.log(f+' is missing '+need);process.exit(1)} } const c=fs.readFileSync('CHANGELOG.md','utf8'); if(!c.includes('## Unreleased')||!c.includes('## 1.0.0 (2026-11-04)')){console.log('CHANGELOG headings');process.exit(1)}"
